title: Tracking symptoms made my routine calmer
content: I started logging my cramps and energy levels every morning. It helped me spot patterns and plan my week with more confidence.

title: Hydration reminder that actually works
content: I keep the water tracker open while I work and it has become a tiny habit that changes my whole day. The progress ring keeps me motivated.

title: Rest is part of the plan
content: Sharing this for anyone who needs it: taking one quiet evening to rest is still progress. Small care counts.

title: Balanced meals helped my energy
content: I paired the nutrition guide with my medication reminders and noticed fewer mid-afternoon crashes. Consistency matters more than perfection.
